description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomFieldAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, testing CRUD operations, validation rules, and interactions with associated services and DAOs.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CustomFieldAPI endpoints, including CRUD operations, validation, and service interactions.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldService
methods.description: Tests that the getCustomFieldService method returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single custom field by ID and verifies the normalization of the output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field with valid data and verifies the returned normalized data.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeExtraData
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field's extraData and ensures related data is deleted appropriately.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeType
methods.description: Tests changing the type of a custom field, with validation for in-use fields and handling of bad requests.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the update endpoint.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a custom field, including error handling when the field is in use or not found.

methods.name: testDeleteNoInUse
methods.description: Tests deletion when the custom field is not in use.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the delete endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new custom field and verifies the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the create endpoint.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all custom fields and verifies the output list.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the getAll endpoint.
